post.title: Free N95 Masks Available – Bad Air Quality
post.message:
With air quality being so rough lately, we have adult N95 masks available for grassroots groups and organizations working with vulnerable populations (e.g. community gardens, food programs.). Not available for individual pickups.

Boxes of 20 individually wrapped masks
Pickup near Markham & Eglinton, Scarborough
Email to arrange pickup: amanda@pamojainstitute.org

About the masks: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m0QCsd3nobE
